day_shape: 81 items: Trump declares US-Iran deal to be signed Sunday with Strait of Hormuz reopening, IDF reports 70+ Hezbollah sites struck near Nabatieh with mass evacuation warnings to 29+ south Lebanon villages, CENTCOM cites 141 vessels redirected under Iran blockade, Khamenei's office pushes national-unity messaging, nothing from UK Parliament.

threads.label: Trump announces imminent US-Iran deal
threads.summary: Trump said a US-Iran deal would be signed Sunday with the Strait of Hormuz reopening immediately, while Pakistani PM Sharif said a framework had been agreed and Qatar sent negotiators to Tehran. Times of Israel and Iran International reported Tehran had not confirmed, with hardline backlash over nuclear terms and frozen funds; Jerusalem Post editorial called the framework 'a disaster'.

threads.label: IDF south Lebanon ground operation
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck over 70 Hezbollah sites in the past day near Nabatieh, killed seven Hezbollah operatives emerging from a tunnel system near Beaufort Castle, and issued evacuation warnings to 29+ south Lebanon villages. Lebanese media reported the Lebanese army had withdrawn from Kfar Tebnit and Israeli artillery shelling in Majdal Zoun and al-Mansouri.

threads.label: Hezbollah drone and rocket fire on north
threads.summary: The IDF said two suspected Hezbollah drones struck an Israeli military zone in the Western Galilee with no injuries, and a rocket fired at troops in southern Lebanon was intercepted with sirens in Metula. Defa Press said the Lebanese resistance announced intensified strikes using Ababil suicide drones against an Israeli Humvee near al-Khiam and a command post near Yahmar al-Shaqif.

threads.label: CENTCOM Hormuz blockade operations
threads.summary: CENTCOM said its forces had redirected 141 commercial vessels and disabled 9 in the Strait of Hormuz blockade against Iran, posting imagery from USS George H.W. Bush, USS Delbert D. Black and USS Abraham Lincoln in the Arabian Sea. Secretary Rubio told Indian EAM Jaishankar that all commercial vessels should immediately comply with US forces' orders in the Strait.

threads.label: Regime unity messaging and post-war framing
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted statements casting national unity as the key factor in defeating the 'Great Satan' and called on artists to record the people's epic, while Defa Press carried former communications minister Zarepour claiming Iran's armed forces 'emerged as a superpower' and a defence-commander interview asserting full self-sufficiency in air defence. IRIB cited a parliamentarian saying 'there is no peace and negotiation is one side of hybrid war' and quoted Ehud Barak that Iran emerged stronger from the war.

threads.label: Iran banking cyberattack
threads.summary: Iran's banking coordination council said a cyberattack had hit shared infrastructure of four major banks, per Jerusalem Post. IRIB said outages at Bank Tejarat and Bank Saderat had been resolved while problems at Bank Melli were still being addressed.

threads.label: Gaza, UNRWA and Hamas
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported UNRWA had fired 70 Gaza staffers following Israeli and UN Watch accusations of Hamas affiliation, with the agency citing safety risks for refugees. Jerusalem Post also reported a new Gaza protest movement calling for mass rallies against Hamas rule on June 26.

events.title: Seven Hezbollah operatives who were operating out of a tunnel in southern Lebanon were killed in strikes this week, the military says.
